verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              पितामहं गुरुं चैव प्रत्युद्गम्य युधिष्ठिरः। अभिवाद्य ततो राजन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said O king, having approached and worshipped his grandfather (Bhishma) and his preceptor (Drona), Yudhishthira thus spoke to,

verses.sanskrit: भीष्मं द्रोणं कृपं द्रौणिं दुर्योधनविविंशती। अस्मिन्यज्ञे भवन्तो मामनुगृह्णन्तु सर्वशः॥२॥
verses.english: Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, the son of Drona (Ashvathama), Duryodhana and Vivanshati. “But all of you gracious to me in my this sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: इदं वः सुमहच्चैव यदिहास्ति धनं मम। प्रणयन्तु भवन्तो मां यथेष्टमभिमन्त्रितः॥३॥
verses.english: All this my great wealth is yours. Consult you all with one another, and guide me as you desire."

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा स तान्सर्वान्दीक्षितः पाण्डवाग्रजः। युयोज स यथायोगमधिकारेष्वनन्तरम्॥४॥
verses.english: Having thus spoken to all, the eldest of the Pandavas (Yudhishthira), who had been already installed in the sacrifice, appointed every one of them in suitable office.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रणयन्तु प्रकर्षेण श्रेयः प्रापयन्तु् अभिमन्त्रिताः प्रार्थिताः सन्तः ॥३॥

verses.english: He appointed Dushasana to superintend the department of food and other enjoyable articles. Ashvathama was solicited to look after the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञां तु प्रतिपूजार्थं सञ्जयं न्ययोजयत्। कृताकृतपरिज्ञाने भीष्णद्रोणौ महामती॥६॥
verses.english: Sanjaya was appointed to return worship to all (invited kings). The high-minded Bhishma and Drona were employed to see what was done and what was left undone.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यस्य सुवर्णस्य रत्नानां चान्ववेक्षणे। दक्षिणानां च वै दाने कृपं राजा न्ययोजयत्॥७॥
verses.english: The king (Yudhishthira) appointed Kripa to look after the diamonds, the gold the pearls and the gems, and he was also appointed to distribute Dakshina (gift) to the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: तथाऽऽन्यान्पुरुषव्याघ्रांस्तस्मिंस्तस्मिन्न्ययोजयत्। बाह्लिको धृतराष्ट्रश्च सोमदत्तो जयद्रथः। नकुलेन समानीताः स्वामिवत्तत्र रेमिरे॥८॥
verses.english: Thus other best of men were all appointed in various other offices. Having been brought there by Nakula, Valhika, Dhritarashtra, Somadatta, and Jayadratha enjoyed there as the lords (of the sacrifice).

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्ता व्ययकरस्त्वासीद्विदुरः सर्वधर्मवित्। दुर्योधनस्त्वर्हणानि प्रतिजग्राह सर्वशः॥९॥
verses.english: Kshatta (Vidura), learned in all the precepts of virtue, became the master of exchequer. Duryodhana became the receiver of tributes brought by the kings.

verses.sanskrit: चरणक्षालने कृष्णो ब्राह्मणानां स्वयं ह्यभूत्। सर्वलोकसमावृत्तः पिप्रीषुः फलमुत्तमम्॥१०॥
verses.english: Krishna, the centre of all men, with the desire of gaining the excellent fruit, him-self willingly took the task of washing the feet of the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टुकामः सभां चैव धर्मराजं यधिष्ठिरम्। न कश्चिदाहरत्तत्र सहस्रावरमर्हणम्॥११॥
verses.english: Wishing to see that Sabha and also Dharmaraja Yudhishthira, no one came there with less tribute than one thousand (in kind) number of quantity).
verses.bhavadeepa: सर्वलोकसमावृत्तः सर्वैः उपायनप्रदैर्लोकैः समावृत्तः वेष्टितः पिप्रीषुः प्रीणयितुमिच्छुः ॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: रत्नैश्च बहुभिस्तत्र धर्मराजमवर्धयत्। कथं तु मम कौरव्यो रत्नदानैः समाप्नुयात्॥१२॥
verses.english: All (the assembled kings) honoured Dharmaraja with large presents of jewels, Every one of those kings proudly said, “Let the Kuru king complete his sacrifice with the gems and wealth that I present to him,(without taking any presents from any other king)”. O king, the sacrificial ground of the illustrious son of Kunti, crowded with guards and warriors, with the cars of the celestialss and with the kings, all possessing beauty and wealth, looked extremely handsome with the numerous palaces, so built as to last for ever, and so high that their tops touched the car of the celestialss who came to see that sacrifice, with the dwellings of the Brahmanas, and the mansions that were built for the king which resembled the cars of the celestialss, and adorned with gems and filled with every king of wealth.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञमित्येव राजानः स्पर्धमाना ददुर्धनम्। भवनैः सविमानाग्रैः सोदर्कैर्बलसंवृतैः॥१३॥

verses.bhavadeepa: सविमानाग्रैः द्रष्टुमागतानां देवानां  विमानैः सहितानि संलग्नानि अग्राणि उपरिभागा येषां तैः ॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रै रत्ववद्भिश्च ऋद्ध्या परमया युतैः। राजभिश्च समावृत्तैरतीव श्रीसमृद्धिभिः। अशोभत सदो राजन्कौन्तेयस्य महात्मनः॥१५॥
verses.bhavadeepa: लोकराजविमानैः इन्द्रादिलोकपालविमानैः लोकराजः स्वर्गो वा तत्रत्यैर्विमानैः स्वर्गिणामप्याश्चर्यकरोऽयं यज्ञ इत्यर्थः ॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: ऋद्ध्या तु वरुणं देवं स्पर्धमानो युधिष्ठिरः। षडग्निनाथ यज्ञेन सोऽयजद्दक्षिणावता॥१६॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira, as if vying with the deity Varuna himself in wealth, commenced the (Rajasuya) sacrifice which was distinguished by large Dakshinas to Brahmanas and emblazoned with the six fires.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाञ्जनान्सर्वकामैः समृद्धैः समतर्पयत्। अन्नवान्बहुभक्ष्यश्च भुक्तवज्जनसंवृतः। रत्नोपहारसम्पन्नो बभूव स समागमः॥१७॥
verses.english: The king gratified every body with present of great value and with every object that one could desire, with abundance of rice and of every kind of food, and also with a large quantity of jewels brought as tribute. Every one of that vast concourse of people was fed to his fill.
verses.bhavadeepa: ऋध्द्या तु वरुणं देवमित्यादेरध्यायशेषस्य तात्पर्यं सर्वाङ्गसंपूर्णोऽयं यश इत्यर्थे । षडग्निना षट् अग्नयः आरभ्मणीयः क्षत्रः धृतिः व्युष्टिः द्विरात्रः दशपेयः इति ॥१६॥

verses.english: The celestialss were gratified in that sacrifice by the Ida, Ghee, Homa and libations poured by the great Rishis, learned in Mantras and pronunciations.
verses.bhavadeepa: रत्नोपहारसंपन्नः इत्यत्र रक्षोपहारकर्मण्यम् इति पाठे रक्षसां नाशे साधुना कर्मणा युक्तः॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: यथा देवास्तथा विप्रा दक्षिणान्नमहाधनैः। ततृपुः सर्ववर्णाश्च तस्मिन्यज्ञे मुदाऽन्विताः॥१९॥
verses.english: Like the celestialss, the Brahmanas were also gratified with the sacrificial gifts, food and great wealth. Men of all the orders were gratified and were filled with joy.
verses.bhavadeepa: इडाकर्म स्विष्टकृदूर्ध्वं  शिंष्ट हविः प्रतिपत्तिकर्म। मन्त्रशिक्षाविशारदैः मन्त्रेषु शिक्षायां हस्तक्रियायां च विशारदैः ऋत्विग्भिः ॥१८॥
